ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-07-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
VJ: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: Gina Gonzales/Lyn Bura, CSR: Susan Lee.
Petitioner: Sergio Cardenas, present in pro per, and as Guardian Ad Litem for Minor: Brenda Angelica Escalera, was sworn and examined.
Co-petitioner/Minor's mother Gabriela Escalera also signed the petition.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Brenda Angelica Cardenas Escalera.
Decree signed in open court.
